source_policy.authority_rule: Governance records the highest confirmed current authority. Judge is historical editing and review lineage only; never infer authorship from approval alone.
source_policy.change_control: Any change to the canonical workbook becomes v10 and returns to the owner for approval. Never edit v9 in place.

transit_meanings.duplicate_resolution: Use the first owner-approved eligible row in canonical workbook order; copy remains byte-identical.

house_activations.duplicate_resolution: Use the first owner-approved eligible row in canonical workbook order; keep Event in the runtime key and preserve copy byte-identically.
exclusion_rules: Exclude rows whose Experience begins with '[EXCLUDE FROM FALLBACK]'.
Exclude rows missing a reusable Planet + Transit sign + House combination.
Do not flatten different Event values into one house entry; keep Event in the runtime key.
